attributes.title: Standard of Care Symposium 2027
attributes.summary:
The Iowa Pharmacy Association runs its Standard of Care Symposium 2027 on Saturday, January 30, 2027, at the West Des Moines Marriott. The one-day program is built around Iowa's standard-of-care approach to pharmacy regulation and is aimed at pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists; attendance is not limited to Iowa licensees.

IPA plans 6.5 hours (0.65 CEU) of live continuing pharmacy education, available to both pharmacists and technicians. Accreditation was still pending when we checked, so the final credit statement is not published yet.

Registration is split into member and non-member links on the IPA event page; the fee amounts were not shown on the page we checked.
